digest:
- AIG CEO Eric Andersen voiced concerns regarding insurer-MGA alignment as excess and surplus lines become more competitive, reinforcing the need for strong capacity partner relationships supporting Nirvana's last-mile commercial auto products [3].
- DoorDash is reportedly planning a $17 billion acquisition of Instacart, consolidating major last-mile delivery platforms and potentially altering courier volume concentrations and commercial auto exposure profiles [14].
- New York City proposed the Delivery Protection Act, prompting stakeholders to debate delivery worker rules and signaling that municipal courier regulations require close monitoring for urban commercial auto risks [1].
- Kemper projected a return to profit while noting that Specialty Auto still posted an underlying underwriting loss, highlighting ongoing profitability pressures in specialty auto sectors relevant to last-mile underwriting [9].
